paragraphs.text: Hilario Zepeda Montaño participated in Shipment MZN-10-05 on 2010-05-09. Bruma del Cobre was linked to Shipment MZN-10-05 on 2010-05-09. Shipment MZN-10-05 occurred at Manzanillo on 2010-05-09. A former bodyguard cooperating with the reporting office stated that Zepeda arranged a small load of 20 kg of cocaine out of Manzanillo toward Phoenix, carried in the tractor-trailer the crews call Tráiler Cerro Pardo Siete. The source described the load as a test of a new driver rather than a commercial run. The source stated that the driver was a cousin of a yard clerk and had never crossed with a load before, which is why the quantity was kept small. The source added that the load was delivered without incident and that the driver was subsequently used for larger runs.

Hilario Zepeda Montaño used DEMO-ACCT-00118 on 2010-05-09. Shipment MZN-10-05 transited Manzanillo port plaza on 2010-05-09. Bruma del Cobre controlled Manzanillo port plaza from 2010-03-14 until 2014-08-02. The source stated that Zepeda paid the driver from the account identified above and that the account was the one he used for all driver payments at this time. The source described the Manzanillo terminal as under the network's control, with yard staff loyal to Anzures clearing containers on request.

Rogelio Anzures Tapia led Bruma del Cobre from 2010-03-14 until 2014-08-02. Hilario Zepeda Montaño was a member of Bruma del Cobre from 2010-03-14 until 2012-07-09. The source described Zepeda as one of the founding members and as the person responsible for the Lázaro Cárdenas side of the network. The reporting office assesses the source as having had direct access to the activity described while employed by the network. The source has provided reporting of comparable quality over the preceding reporting cycle.
